title: Architectural Practice Certificate 2026: Conditions, Exam, Procedure
desc: Architectural practice certificate (2019 Law on Architecture): who needs one, 3 years' experience, 70-point exam, dossier, issuing body, 10-year term, renewal.
summary: Conditions, examination, dossier and procedure for issuing and renewing an architectural practice certificate under the 2019 Law on Architecture and Decree 85/2020/ND-CP.
body: p

Architectural design of works is not licensed through a construction practice certificate; it is governed by architecture law (Article 28 of Decree 212/2026/ND-CP). This article summarises the rules on the architectural practice certificate under the 2019 Law on Architecture and Decree 85/2020/ND-CP.
h2
1. Who must hold an architectural practice certificate?
p
Under Article 21 of the Law on Architecture, a certificate is required for anyone who:
ul
Holds the position of lead architectural designer;
Is the person professionally responsible for architecture within an architectural practice organisation;
Is an architect practising as an individual (Article 25).
p

A person without a certificate may still take part in architectural services within an architectural practice organisation or in cooperation with an individually practising architect. Architects' offices and architecture companies must have a certificate-holding person as lead or professionally responsible person, and must notify the provincial-level architecture authority (Article 33).
h2
2. Conditions for being issued a certificate
p
Under Clause 1, Article 28, an individual must:
ol
Hold a qualification of university level or above in architecture;
Have at least 3 years of experience in architectural services at an architectural practice organisation or in cooperation with an individually practising architect;
Pass the examination.
p

A person with 10 consecutive years of direct state management, university teaching in architecture or architectural practice is exempt from the examination; a person who has won a national or international architecture award is exempt from the experience requirement (Clauses 3 and 4, Article 28).
h2
3. What does the examination cover?
p
Under Article 26 of the Law on Architecture and Article 25 of Decree 85/2020/ND-CP:
ul
A 100-point question set: professional experience (40 points), law (20), expertise (20), professional code of conduct (20).
First-time issuance: a multiple-choice test and an oral examination.
A pass requires a total of at least 70 points, at least 16 points in the law section and at least 50% in each other section.
The examination result is valid for up to 12 months.
h2
4. Dossier, where to submit, processing time
p
Dossier for a new certificate (Clause 1, Article 27 of Decree 85/2020/ND-CP):
ol
Application form in Appendix III, with 2 colour photos (4x6 cm, white background) taken within the last 6 months.
A relevant university degree (a foreign degree must come with a notarised or certified translation).
The investor's assignment decision or confirmation of the representative work done; for independent practice, enclose contracts and acceptance records.
A valid, passing examination result.
ul
Submit 1 set in person, online or by post to the architecture authority under the provincial People's Committee (Article 29).
Processing time: 15 days (new issuance), 5 days (reissuance), 10 days (renewal) from receipt of a complete and valid dossier (Article 28).
The certificate is valid for 10 years and is usable nationwide (Article 27).
h2
5. Renewal and revocation
p

A certificate is renewed when it expires, provided there is continuing professional development and no breach of the code of conduct (Clause 2, Article 28). It is revoked for falsified dossiers, serious breaches of the code of conduct, professional errors causing serious consequences, and similar grounds (Article 30). A homeowner hiring a designer should ask for the lead architect's name and certificate number; see also Designing your own house: when you must hire a design firm.
note

This article is a summary for reference only and does not replace the legal texts. The Law on Architecture 2019 and Decree 85/2020/ND-CP are both partly expired; Decree 85/2020/ND-CP has been amended (the consolidated text 12/VBHN-BXD is not yet in full in our library), so the dossier and time limits may have changed. Check with the Department of Construction where you will submit the dossier.
